questions.question: When some Pharisees came to test Jesus, what did they ask Him about?

answers.text: Whether a man may divorce his wife
Whether people should pay taxes to Caesar
Whether it is right to heal on the Sabbath

questions.question: Why did Jesus say Moses wrote the command allowing a certificate of divorce?

answers.text: Because the elders asked for it
Because God wanted it that way

questions.question: Jesus said a husband and wife stay two separate people after they are united in marriage. True or false?
Jesus taught the Pharisees that God is the one who joins a husband and wife together. True or false?
